sentinels_gaze.name: Sentinel's Gaze

dune_runners_shortbow.name: Dune Runner's Shortbow

voidbinder.name: Voidbinder

voidbinder.lore: It slips between realities. You are never sure where the blade really is.

unravelers_sigil.name: Unraveler's Sigil

unravelers_sigil.lore: The Unraveler used this to pull threads from the fabric of being.

gauntlets_of_void.name: Gauntlets of the Void

gauntlets_of_void.lore: Everything they touch loses something. No one knows what.

staff_of_primordial.name: Staff of the Primordial

staff_of_primordial.lore: Before there was a world, there was this. Then: everything else.

plate_of_creation.name: Plate of Creation

necklace_final_seal.name: Necklace of the Final Seal

dragon_kings_headguard.name: Dragon-King's Headguard

ancient_dragon_scale.lore: Scales shed only once, at the end of an Age. You hold the last one.
